_source: v2, 2026-09-28: one-time enumeration and classification of every surviving finding of rounds 1-9 (alt/register/rows_v2.tsv: 486 rows from the A1 enumeration plus 88 survivors the round-8 findings.tsv omitted, missing_rows.tsv / RECON.md; A1 flags and three RCA-seat moves applied, each recorded in its row), folded with the inventory of every RCA conducted (alt/register/rca_inventory.json) and the bulk RCAs owed by the rebuild (alt/rca/RCA-BULK-{1,2,3}.md). v1 was seeded from the round-8 classification of rounds 1-7 and never received a round-8 member. Counts derive from rows_v2.tsv by build_v2.py.
_status: open: no detector; detector: a command enumerates every seam; barriered: that command is a CI check.
_counting: An instance is a judged survivor or an instance counted beyond it (a sweep, RCA or fixer seat found the seam and it is not the judged site); non_round_instances are incidents and screens, listed, not counted. trigger.per_round is the rule in force (defect-root-cause.md:87-91); trigger.cross_round is the proposed clause (>=3 over any 3 consecutive rounds, or >=5 total while open), owner-gated in R9-EG-R1.

P1.mechanism: A non-finite, malformed or out-of-domain value crosses an input boundary (persisted store, live entity, external feed, service call) with no guard
P1.detector: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/finite_boundary.py -- Arm 1 derives the boundary set from the tree; Arm 4 (round 9, F1.6) seeds every store through its real saver at an aware clock with a configured zone, substitutes every leaf, container and int-like dict key by kind (non-finite, wrong-type, magnitude, naive-twin), and scans everything the coordinator owns after the real loaders and consumers for a raise, a non-finite, a naive instant, an absurd magnitude or a number turned text
P1.detector_idea: Enumerate every Store/async_load and every float field its from_dict reads; fuzz each with nan/inf/malformed strings across the whole store roster
P1.barrier: QuarantiningStore._sanitize quarantines a number, numeric string or numeric dict key of magnitude >= ABSURD (1e15) exactly as it does a non-finite one (the round-9 P1 RCA's countermeasure, prototype handoff/r9-rca-p1@0ade2456), so no loader decides finiteness or magnitude any more; instants load through drift.stored_instant (F3.1/F3.2) and the naive sub-shape is refused by the same Arm 4; the remaining store-read seams (the fuse advisor's stamp, the snapshot restore's learners payload, the accuracy samples' t, the immersion events) load through the same rules in F1.6. Measured: Arm 4 red on main 5395394d with 95 seams (91 magnitude leaves/keys, 3 naive, 1 wrong-type restore) over 4706 mutants, zero at the F1.6 head; the finder's detector p1_store.py reads p1_escaping_mutants 5 -> 0, p1_wedged_seams 2 -> 0. Not reached, the RCA's stated residue, per-seam in their instance PRs: out-of-domain but bounded values, and a loader discarding a whole valid grid for one bad cell -- a declared-domain barrier is card C1 (F9.3). P1-sw1/sw2 (comfort NaN leaves) are defence-in-depth, not instances: through the real store a NaN leaf is None before from_dict. The live-input plausibility boundary of the class's widened mechanism (the fetched weather forecast rows, the forecast fabricated from the entity's current attributes when a first fetch fails, the ECL110 state displace, the DHW tank sample) landed with F1.6 too. Its seams are enumerated by the S6 rule tools/audit/round9/D14/sweep/live-input-no-plausibility-bound/enumerate.sh, whose family C greps `float(state.state)` and so CANNOT see a path that reads `state.attributes` -- the fabricated forecast is that path, and the F1.6 fix review found it with a probe of its own rather than with the enumerator (measured: attributes temperature=1e308 and wind_speed=1e6 each gave the finder's poisoned_series=1 before the fix, 0 after). A later round re-using this enumerator must pair it with an attributes-read rule or name that blind spot, as F1.1's brief requires of the P7 static enumerator
P1.mechanism_note: Widened 2026-09-29, tvofi's ruling on the v2 register: R1-7 already held live-input and output-boundary rows (R5 D1-06 'nan' sensor state, R5 D1-07 weather feed, R2 D8-02 numpy scalars to attributes) that cross no persisted store; R8 D1-s3-01 (Open-Meteo shape) and the R9 re-maps N-plausibility (finite-but-absurd live input), N-min-gap (one off-grid stamp voids a feed) and N-service-clamp (unbounded service input) add more, and R9 D1-s5-02/D1-s3-06 are finite-but-out-of-domain. The detector idea (fuzz the store roster) reaches none of the non-store members

P3.detector_idea: Every max(<capacity>, <constant>) cross-referenced against unclamped reads of the same variable

P4.mechanism: The optimizer seed set or stop tolerance does not bracket the optimum
P4.detector_idea: Per fixture cell, production multi-start against a dense seed grid on the identical objective
P4.barrier_refusal: Class-eliminating barrier refused on numbers (RCA-BULK-1): tighter ftol cost 6.4 % money on one backtest cell at 2.4x CPU (#1293, #1294, owner-refused); the certificate stays the detector

P5.mechanism: A sysid/adoption gate keyed on a quantity other than the bias it gates
P5.detector: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/features.py, R9-P5 block: every house_* keyword of SystemIdentification.step is fitted or names the sysid width the adoption interval prices it with, and every told-quantity night on the three presets, single- and two-zone, adopts within the bar of the plant's heat loss or is refused
P5.detector_idea: Synthetic-bias sweep: the gate decision must be monotone in the true injected bias
P5.barrier: The adoption interval prices every told quantity (intercept prior, slab pair) by how far one declared width moves log UA, and the R9-P5 sweep in tests/features.py runs on the PR gate (F4.2, #1655), with the #1524 liveness checks refusing a gate that refuses everything. Not reached: free heat past the prior's own band, which one night cannot separate from heat loss; it needs the learned free-heat prior in coordinator.py (.claude/workflows/carry-1655.json)
P5.mechanism_note: Stretched to model-structure mismatch in the fit (already R1 D7-02, R4 D7-01); R9 N-fit-integrator (coarser integrator than the plant) re-mapped here, which puts it under the barriered class's obligation (F4.2 carried both).
aliases: N-fit-integrator
new: fit integrator differs from the simulated plant

P6.mechanism: A consumer reads a key or field no producer writes, with a silent fallback
P6.detector_idea: Static cross-reference of coordinator.data/hass.data reads against the keys _build_data_dict writes
P6.mechanism_note: Stretched. R1-7 already held swallowed failures (R1 D10-07, R2 D10-04) that read no missing key; R9 N-debug-swallow (persistent failure logged at DEBUG) re-mapped here; R8 D7-s1-03 is a refusal path that writes no reason, read back as the default 'ok'.

P7.mechanism: Naive wall-clock datetime arithmetic across a DST transition
P7.detector: HASTUB_TZ=Europe/Stockholm PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/dst_checks.py (its DST tracer section; tests/features.py runs the script)
P7.detector_idea: Every datetime-difference and grid-construction site across the DST transition days, against a UTC reference
P7.barrier: tests/dst_checks.py's DST tracer on the PR gate (F1.1, #1665): the committed replay day, shifted onto a spring, an autumn and a plain day, runs through replay.run_fixture with Home Assistant's zoned clock traced, and a subtraction of two stamps sharing the zone, or a + timedelta on one, whose result differs from the UTC arithmetic fails the check, keyed on (file, function). Reaches every seam a replayed cycle executes, including operands the static enumerator cannot name (result.timestamps); not reached: a seam no replayed cycle drives, and arithmetic between two datetimes production builds itself from stored text. tariff._window_slot is exempt: a wall-clock tariff label by definition
P7.barrier_gap: RCA-BULK-1 measured two blind spots of the F1.1 tracer: the R3 tariff seam (#777; the replay fixture configures no capacity tariff) and the R5 plan-age seam (#1299; its operands never straddle the transition in the replayed day). Both re-introduced shapes pass main's dst_checks.py. 13 raw zoned-datetime sites remain (services.py:873 / manual_plan.py:288: a 20 h override lasts 21 h across the autumn fold). Owed: a config arm and a straddle arm (R9-F10.1c)

P8.mechanism: A currency or unit resolved by divergent precedence on different surfaces
P8.detector_idea: The published money unit is the price feed's currency: replay with a EUR/kWh feed on a SEK instance and count published money units in the instance currency (11/11 at 3490cb16; 0 when fixed). currency.py already is the one shared resolver, and it canonicalises the instance label, not the feed: forcing every surface through it (#1657's proposal) would lock the defect in (RCA-BULK-1)

P9.mechanism: Card UI: a clipping ancestor, missing colour token or unfloored hit target
P9.detector: node tests/card_browser.mjs (the browser job), its P9 grid: 31 card states in 9 cells (3 widths x en/sv light, 375 px dark, and HA's theme against the opposite OS scheme both ways, hass.themes.darkMode in lockstep), each asserting over every rendered node WCAG AA text contrast over what is underneath, zero shared glyph ink between text runs, pop-ups inside the viewport and their chart, listbox options distinct as shown, no unreachable clipped ink, and the 24 px target floor or WCAG 2.5.8's spacing exception; controls: every cell mounted and every driver step found its target, and every card rule that sets a colour rendered in some cell
P9.detector_idea: The browser geometry sweep over every rendered node: hit-target floor, contrast, clip against its ancestor
P9.barrier: The P9 grid is a zero rule with no allow-list in the browser CI job (R9-F6.3, #1652), shown failing on each round-9 instance re-introduced and on a catalogue with the status states dropped. HPO_BROWSER_SCOPE=auto skips it on a diff that touches none of the card files, the grid scripts or tests/plan_view.py's measured closure in tests/closures.json (the solver, profiles and stubs that build the payload), and prints that it did; a push always runs it. No grid state crowds a lane enough to contest two slot-hit targets, so their non-overlap is a tests/card.mjs unit on slotHitExtents. Not reached: keyboard routes (the grid drives a pointer; F6.2's lane), and states the catalogue does not drive, which the reach control bounds only for colour rules. Setting the scope variable in tests.yml is F11.7's (.claude/workflows/carry-1757.json)
P9.mechanism_note: Stretched to keyboard access: R8 D4-01 (Tab order) and R9 N-keyboard (pointer-only editing) are card accessibility rules that do not reach a control, the class's shape, but the mechanism text names only clipping/colour/hit target.
aliases: N-keyboard
new: pointer-only editing with no keyboard route

P10.mechanism: CPU work (a model kernel, a fit, a batch simulation) runs outside the process worker, on the event loop or on a GIL-holding executor thread, and starves the loop
P10.detector_idea: Count model-kernel calls outside the process worker over a replayed day: 2304 on the loop at 3490cb16 (topology.py _advisor_replay), 0 with the advisor removed, 3926 on an executor thread when the worker is forced to fail (RCA-BULK-1 p10_loop_kernels.py); extend the kernel list to sysid
P10.mechanism_note: Widened from "a solve on a GIL-holding thread starves the loop" (RCA-BULK-1): R9 re-minted it as N-loop-cpu because the v1 text excluded loop-inline work
aliases: N-loop-cpu
new: CPU work inline on the event loop

I1.mechanism: A mutation kill miscounted, or a guard whose deletion leaves the gate green
I1.detector_idea: Count a kill only on at least one failing assertion; re-run previously surviving mutants
I1.mechanism_note: Stretched to performance gates: R2 D9-02, R4 D9-06, R5 D9-07, R6 D9-02 already here; R8 D9-s2-01 and the R9 re-map N-cpu-gate-blind (a 2x regression outside the sampled work leaves the gate green) join them.
aliases: N-cpu-gate-blind
new: CPU gate blind to a regression outside its sampled work

N-cpu-gate-blind.detector: Three parts, all CI checks (round 9, F10.2). PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/stress.py: the plant-axis coverage section builds every sweep case against a sentinel solve and refuses a selectable topology layout or mixing-valve mode no case reaches (D9-s2-71: 0 of 51 valve plants; the sweep now carries three summer valve plants, manual single-tank, smart_read direct-slab and smart_write two-tank wood); the same script's production-call channel sees non-kernel solve work the per-call CPU sample never meters when it is made of Python calls, the shape of every round-9 instance (D9-s2-03; the finder's own arm injects a call-free spin, which stays the CPU factors' residual below). python3 tests/replay.py: loop_cpu_ratio, the cycle thread's CPU less executor jobs, against a budget recorded on the canonical runner, with a doubled-loop arm that must go over (D9-s2-02).
N-cpu-gate-blind.barrier: tests/stress.py and tests/replay.py in the Tests workflow, closure-scoped on a pull request and full on main
N-cpu-gate-blind.residual: Known, not findings (card C9): the valve plants are sampled in summer and the throttling valve's winter two-zone path stays outside the sample; the coverage check refuses an unreached valve mode, not an unreached valve-mode and season pair. The loop figure reads one fixture. A call-free per-call slowdown is the CPU factors' alone (see N-solve-recompute's residual).

I2.mechanism: A measured closure or scope diverges from the real dependency graph
I2.detector_idea: Nightly strace -f of the gate against the committed closures, reporting files the recorder missed (child-process reads, .pyc-only loads); over-scope needs no barrier (RCA-BULK-2)
I2.mechanism_note: R8 D3-s1-02 is a cache key whose input set diverges from what the capture reads: scope-vs-real-dependency, same shape.

I3.mechanism: A required governance/CI check is skipped, runs a stale ref, or has a bypassable boundary
I3.detector_idea: The ruleset-reading code against the live ruleset; every required-context job checks out the PR head
I3.barrier: field_coverage.mjs in governance.yml policy-docs (F11.3, #1648): every leaf of a registered check's input (settings.json hooks, the live ruleset, each capped policy file's size row, the budget-raise gate's owner review) is perturbed and the real check run; a leaf it stays green on is BLIND unless ignored with a reason; the check set is derived from policy_lint.mjs CHECKS, codeowners_gap.py PINNED and stamp.py rule 4, and an unregistered check is refused. Runs when its inputs change, and on the schedule. Not read: D11-s1-02, D11-s1-03, D11-s1-04, D13-s1-03, and the write-grant workflow pin's inputs in tests/entities.py (carry-1648's second entry: that pin is not callable without running the whole script).

I4.mechanism: Two independent parsers or definitions of one concept disagree
I4.detector_idea: Per reader pair, generated boundary cases asserting both readers give the same verdict

N-future-instant.mechanism: A persisted instant stamped by a clock that ran ahead is trusted verbatim on load, so every now-minus-stamp window it opens holds for the clock's whole error
N-future-instant.detector: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/finite_boundary.py (the instant arm drives every store's loader with every stored instant 400 days ahead)
N-future-instant.detector_idea: Bound every stored instant at the store-load boundary instead of linting parse sites: the sweep's AST lint was refused because it accepts a no-op use-time clamp and misses parse_datetime
N-future-instant.barrier: QuarantiningStore(lead=...) rewrites an instant leaf beyond now plus its store's lead to that bound before any loader sees it; the instant arm of tests/finite_boundary.py fails on an escape and on an opt-out not listed with its reason (#1660); a naive leaf is bounded in the zone its loader reads it in (F3.2). Not reached: FI-sw3, _detect_outage's stored last_tick -- restore and read share one now, so a stamp bounded to it gives gap 0 and the outage stays masked (the RCA's repro_loaders.py: outage_flagged_after_6h_cut null True, skewed False at F3.1's merge); no bound closes it, and it waits on tvofi's rule in F1.9
aliases: new: persisted future instant trusted without bound

P11.mechanism: The only oracle for an external counterpart (Home Assistant core, its state machine, its recorder REST API, a device behind an integration) is a test double the implementer wrote from what the code needed, so the tests agree with a wrong implementation
P11.detector_idea: Per seam, an enumerating sweep that drives every production call site through a double whose behaviour is cited to upstream source or measured on the device; tests/entities.py's entity-action sweep (handoff/v6612-root-cause) is the first
P11.barrier: tests/ha_contract.py on the PR gate (F10.1, #1649): a contract that reached none of its asserts fails; every expect=both contract of a symbol a test hook feeds (HOOKS: dt_util.freeze) re-runs in each hook state; every parameter a stub accepts and never reads must be declared in DROPPED. Reaches the vacuous-contract, hook and dropped-parameter routes (D1-s1-52's contract, D14-s4-02, D1-s2-71); the naive default clock itself (D1-s1-52) is declared DIVERGENT with an expect=real contract and split into its own PR. Not reached: behaviour inside a method (D1-s1-51, covered per instance by the Store decode contract and probe), an upstream symbol the stub does not model (D10-s1-03), and doubles outside tests/hastub (D6-s1-81); the RCA (round 9, P11) leaves the last to tvofi
P11.non_round_note: Incident-derived instances carried in v1; not audit findings, not in register_rows.tsv, not counted in total.

N-restart.mechanism: A user-set state does not survive a restart: the setter persisted it later than the action (the end of a cycle, a queued platform slot), or not at all
N-restart.detector: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/features.py, the RC2 block and its F1.4 extension: every entity action and coordinator setter is a durability row or says where its state lives (check 1); each row returns before a refresh that never completes and a second coordinator on the same entry shows what it set; the five cycle writers run against a startup read held open by a gate and the persisted learned marker must survive the writer (D1-s2-52); every set_thermal_parameters field that changes state survives a restart through entry options, enumerated from the service schema so a new field is refused until classified (D1-s2-53)
N-restart.detector_idea: The S5 enumerators are the two D1-leads harnesses (enumerate_store_race.py, enumerate_params_restart.py), exhaustive over the coordinator's five stores and the service's 26 state-changing fields
N-restart.barrier: The RC2 block (#1641) classified every entity action and setter; F1.4 extends it with the two seams the sweep confirmed it did not cover. D1-s2-52: each of the five cycle writers awaits its store's async_wait_for_read BEFORE building its payload -- the payload snapshots memory, so a save-side wait alone leaves the disk stale (the round-1 shape did, caught by the review: memory survived, a third restart lost 5 of 5) -- and QuarantiningStore.async_save itself also waits, as defence-in-depth for every other writer. D1-s2-53: async_update_thermal_params writes the call's fields into entry options, the async_set_target_temperature route, whose options write reloads the entry and rebuilds the model. The barrier check reads the marker from a THIRD clean restart after the race, the finding's harm sentence made measurable. Sweep S5 (@51a2e98a86) re-measured both instances at the merge base: lost=5 of 5 stores, lost=24 of 26 fields; both zero at the head
aliases: new: user state not surviving restart
N-restart.non_round_note: Incident-derived instances carried in v1; not audit findings, not in register_rows.tsv, not counted in total.

N-solve-recompute.mechanism: The solve recomputes interpreter-bound work per iterate or per row that is invariant or vectorisable (per-row Python loops, uncached parameter derivations, scalar re-evaluation, polishes whose result is discarded)
N-solve-recompute.detector: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/stress.py, the production-call channel (round 9, F10.2): one member of every sweep family, the cheapest recorded, is solved on this tree and on the merge base in fresh interpreters under sys.monitoring, counting PY_START and CALL events per production file; growth beyond what the evaluation and simulate counts vouch for, over SCENARIO_CALLS_GROWTH (5 %, re-derived over 13 first-parent solver merges, 2.35 % largest legitimate) on an unchanged plan, fails. The count is exact, so a per-row or per-iterate recompute the CPU factors' noise hides is refused: RC-rca1's per-row loop re-introduced fires 16 of 20 scenarios at up to 3.3x, F2.2's and F2.5's fixes reverted fire 20 and 18 of 20
N-solve-recompute.detector_idea: S5 enumerate.py: profiled call counts per (module, qualname) against a once-per-solve boundary; recompute_instances may only fall
N-solve-recompute.barrier: The channel's checks in tests/stress.py's work-drift section, which the Tests workflow runs on every pull request whose closure reaches the solve and in full on main; a merge that adds such work on purpose passes for that one pull request on tvofi's approving review on the red channel, never by raising SCENARIO_CALLS_GROWTH
N-solve-recompute.mechanism_difference: P10 is where the solve runs (a GIL-holding thread starving the loop); this is avoidable CPU inside the solve wherever it runs, fixed by vectorising or caching, not by moving work off the loop
aliases: new: avoidable interpreter-bound recomputation in the solve
N-solve-recompute.residual: Known, not a finding: a per-call slowdown that adds no Python call (a vectorised operation done twice, a larger array) moves CPU without moving the count -- the doubled peak_cost_batch arm reads 1.04x and stays under; the CPU factors remain its only gate.

N-structure-blind.mechanism: A structural ratchet or dead-code metric measures a name or regex proxy instead of the property it gates, so dead production members or cross-seam coupling pass it unmeasured
N-structure-blind.detector_idea: Liveness by reachability from production roots (tests are not roots), with a self-check planting one example per past shape and a printed count of shapes the metric cannot measure (RCA-BULK-2)
N-structure-blind.mechanism_difference: I4 is two maintained readers of one concept disagreeing; here there is one in-tree metric, blind to a code shape (rename, module-level helper(self), property, attribute-only load), and the second reader exists only as an audit harness
aliases: N-dead-member
new: production member reached by no production code
new: structure metric blind to a code shape

N-approval-rebuy.mechanism: An approval or verdict is bound to the exact head SHA rather than to the diff it reviewed, so a diff-identical head move (a merge from main, a ci: commit) re-buys the review
N-approval-rebuy.detector_idea: Per merged PR, patch-id of the reviewed diff vs the merged diff; count re-verifications whose patch-id did not change
N-approval-rebuy.mechanism_difference: I3 is enforcement too weak (skipped, stale, bypassable); this is enforcement keyed on the wrong identity, costing rounds without catching defects
aliases: new: an approval bound to an exact head is re-bought on a diff-identical move

N-finally-return.mechanism: A return inside finally swallows an in-flight exception, cancellation included

N-step-grid.mechanism: A number selector's minimum or default is not on its own step grid, so native validity flags legal values and a spinner click lands off-grid
N-step-grid.detector_idea: S7 selector_min_off_step_grid enumerate.py: every box-mode NumberSelector (min - base) % step == 0

aliases: new: selector minimum off its own step grid

N-reap-lock.mechanism: Shutdown reaps the solve worker only after acquiring the lock a long solve holds, so stop latency is the solve's remaining time
N-reap-lock.detector_idea: Stop latency ratio vs an unlocked reap (the finder harness perturbation)
N-reap-lock.mechanism_difference: P2 lifecycle rows (R2 D1-02, R9 D1-s3-02) are a missing guard; this is lock ordering between shutdown and an in-flight solve
aliases: new: shutdown reap waits on the lock a solve holds

N-staleness.mechanism: A staleness limit is shorter than a report-on-change source's legitimate quiet interval, so a valid unchanged reading is declared stale or unavailable
N-staleness.detector_idea: S6 staleness-limit-shorter-than-quiet-interval enumerate.sh: silence cells beyond each INPUT_MAX_AGE limit
N-staleness.mechanism_difference: P6 misses staleness behind a silent fallback; this declares false staleness
aliases: new: staleness limit shorter than a report-on-change sensor's quiet interval

N-silent-zero.mechanism: A derivation's failure path returns the same empty value as its success path, so a count over a set never enumerated reads as a clean zero
N-silent-zero.detector_idea: Register count-printing instruments (structure.py dead_*, stress sampling, policy_lint --stats) in field_coverage.mjs's perturb-to-red registry; merge_shape_guard for the merge-subject derivation
N-silent-zero.mechanism_difference: I1 is a mutation kill miscounted or a vacuous guard; this is any derivation (a census, a sample, a --stats line) whose failure is indistinguishable from an empty success
